decisions.reason: As a core extension of the firm's garage-door system business with its own page and strong fit to existing sales, service and production capabilities, the option value of keeping it open is high and the carrying cost is low.

The solid wood sectional garage door looks like a niche but credible premium variant for the firm's customization-focused portfolio, so management would likely keep it on offer while market response is still uncertain.

Although it may overlap with the broader operator range, remote-control functionality is commercially close to the firm's core offer and inexpensive to continue testing for demand through the existing channel.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door appears only as a mention while a seemingly overlapping glazed industrial door has stronger standalone presentation, management would likely rationalize the weaker option and release resources.

An insulated glazed industrial door matches the firm's emphasis on thermal, compliant and building-specific solutions, so the product's strategic fit and remaining uncertainty favor keeping the option alive.

With its own page and clear alignment to the firm's industrial door competencies, this product likely has enough strategic importance and low enough continuation cost to justify staying on the market.
